cmd: tc filter add dev dummy1 parent ffff: handle 0xffffffff prio 1 protocol all matchall action continue
desc: positive: Add ingress matchall filter for all protocols and action CONTINUE with handle at 32-bit maximum

match.pattern: (?sm)^filter parent ffff: protocol all pref 1 matchall.*handle 0xffffffff.*gact action continue.*ref 1 bind 1

pre: ip link add dummy1 type dummy && ip link set dummy1 up
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 ingress

readback.cmd: tc filter get dev dummy1 parent ffff: handle 0xffffffff prio 1 protocol all matchall
readback.name: verify
